description: Federal-only baseline (no province configured, work_state omitted -> provincial tax resolves to $0 per canada.py's own 'no state_slabs -> 0, never a guess' contract) — CPP, EI, and federal income tax at their real ZP-TAX-CA-2026-001 2026 rates/brackets, no TD1/LSVCC declarations, no YTD accumulator wired. federal_income_tax/tds updated 2026-09-11 (gap-closure Phase 1): the CRA-correct credit method and the federal K2/K3 CPP/EI credit are now enabled by default, so this same income is $40.02/yr lower even though it never leaves the lowest bracket — that drop is entirely K2/K3 (a genuinely new credit on CPP/EI actually withheld this period), not the BPA credit-vs-deduction divergence (which only matters once income crosses a bracket).
source: ZP-TAX-CA-2026-001 v1.0: Section 6 (federal 2026 brackets + BPAF hardcoded fallback $16,452, CEA $1,501), Section 10 (CPP base 4.95%+first-additional 1.00% = 5.95% combined, employer identical), Section 11 (EI employee 1.63%/employer 2.282%, Canada except Quebec). Hand-verified against the document's own bracket table and cross-checked by running the actual engine (build_context/calculate_payroll) at authoring time -- not run through CRA PDOC.
